content:
**PR 4 of #998 — the SDD view's seven-stage matrix and the archive reader**

readChanges (status/snapshot.mjs) now also lists openspec/changes/archive/<issue> rows (archived: true, same shape, plus a per-row artefacts{} presence map for all seven stage files, asked directly rather than filtered through the tier-scoped missing list). lib/sdd-model.mjs's buildSddModel(changesSection, {tier}) turns that section into one row per change: seven stages (proposal/spec/design/tasks/apply/verify/archive) each present/missing/in-progress/done/not-applicable, the task count, the slice plan as declared scope only ("PR state is not read"), and named phase-order violations — a local pure restatement of vcs/phase-order-check.mjs's Rule A intent (not an import: that module reads node:child_process/node:fs at module scope and sdd-model.mjs is loaded directly by the browser, D9). A grandfathered change claims no stage; an archived change's own archived:true is its archive stage's fact, no archive-report.md required. app.js's sdd mode router now draws this matrix instead of the PR-4 placeholder sentence (view-model.mjs's PLACEHOLDERS.sdd is null, alongside map); app.css styles it from the existing token block only.

The full suite's own stage-array drift guard (lib/sdd-layout.test.mjs) caught sdd-model.mjs's local LIFECYCLE_ORDER literal as a bare-name rival of sdd-layout.mjs's LIFECYCLE_STAGES; fixed with a REVIEWED allowlist entry (D9 reason) and a test pinning the two arrays equal, rather than importing sdd-layout.mjs into a browser-loaded module.

Full suite GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null npm test: 5639/0 (PR 3 left it at 5624/0; +15 new tests). npm run brain:repo:check green before every commit. Counted diff 25b1d6b2...HEAD (tests, openspec/changes/** excluded): 371/400.

Deviations from the design/tasks sketch, said: the slice plan's rows carry claims (the requirement ids a slice claims), not files — sdd-layout.mjs's parseSliceScopes validates and keeps slice/claims/terminal_pr from the brain-slice-scope/1 block and drops the JSON block's files array; extending that parser was outside this PR's assigned file list (lib/sdd-model.mjs, snapshot.mjs, static/app.js). The archive dir naming convention recognised is exactly archivePath()'s bare-issue-number shape (ARCHIVE_ID_RE = /^\d+$/); this repo's own pre-convention dated-slug archive dirs (e.g. 2026-07-26-issue-334-...) are not eligible rows — same filtering posture the active-change list already has via parseChangeId.

Carried: PR 5 (findings per verdict, the reviews timeline, the queue) is next.
